parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host instance.
You can call the DescribeInstances operation to obtain the bastion host instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
可通过调用DescribeInstances接口获取堡垒机实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host. 
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。 
Region ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the projects that you want to delete.
You can call the ListProjects operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
要删除的项目ID数组。
您可以调用ListProjects接口获取该参数
parameters.name: project_ids
